input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
input.rationale: The licence is perpetual while fees are paid and terminable only on insolvency or uncured material breach (§17), so it is not revocable at will. However, the grant covers affiliates only where they operate at Authorized Locations, omits contractors acting on our behalf, and is expressly "non-transferable" with assignment barred absent Garman's consent (§3(c), §20(d)), leaving no successor path. The redline extends the grant to affiliates and contractors (with us responsible for their compliance) and permits transfer to a successor of the business, matching the preferred position.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Sparkling's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, delete "non-transferable" and permit transfer to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to Sparkling's affiliated companies and to contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf (with Sparkling remaining responsible for their compliance), and removed the blanket "non-transferable" restriction so the licence can pass to a successor of the business. Our playbook requires affiliate and contractor coverage and successor transferability; if helpful we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to Garman as a fallback.
